plans.hint: What {{location}} bakes each day. Confirming a plan creates its batches.
plans.caption: Production plans

planForm.enough: Enough raw materials on hand for this plan.

plan.subtitle: {{date}} · {{location}}
plan.cancelHint: Its batches that haven't started are cancelled too. Nothing has left stock yet.
plan.draftHint: Confirm the plan to create a batch for each product.

batches.title: Production batches
batches.hint: Each run at {{location}}: start it to use the raw materials, then record what came out.
batches.caption: Production batches

batch.cancelHint: The batch hasn't started, so no stock has moved.

start.hint_one: {{count}} run, {{expected}} expected. Record what was actually used — it leaves stock now.
start.hint_other: {{count}} runs, {{expected}} expected. Record what was actually used — it leaves stock now.

output.title: Output of {{number}} · {{name}}
output.hint: {{expected}} expected. Good units go into finished goods; rejects are recorded as wastage.
output.preview: {{total}} out of the oven → {{good}} {{goodUnit}} into stock, {{rejected}} to wastage

goods.hint: Bakery products on hand at {{location}}. Transfer them to the shops from the stock page.
goods.caption: Finished goods
goods.empty: No bakery products with a production formula

wastage.title: Wastage
wastage.hint: Batch rejects and finished goods written off at {{location}}, from the stock ledger.
wastage.caption: Wastage

wastageDialog.hint_other: {{count}} {{unit}} on hand at {{location}}. A manager confirms with their PIN and a reason.
wastageDialog.tooMany: That's more than is on hand

formulas.title: Formulas
formulas.hint: What one batch run of each bakery product uses and makes. A change applies to plans confirmed from now on; plans already confirmed keep what they were planned with.
formulas.caption: Production formulas
